title: Choose Consumit's member-space layout
question: These three options keep the existing dark, orange-accented Consumit style and redesign how Profile, Library, Circle, Favorites, and Lists fit together. Which composition makes a member's taste and records easiest to understand? The focused Watch screen will use the same identity with its own player layout.

options.label: Member Workspace
options.lineage: A clear member workspace with one profile header and purposeful destinations.
options.thesis: Keep identity in view while each destination gets the layout that fits its job.
options.viewport: A compact profile masthead spans the content column; a single row of labeled member tabs leads into an activity feed, with Favorites and Lists in a slim right rail. Library and Circle retain the same header and navigation while replacing the body with their own work surfaces.
options.risk: A shared member header can consume too much space on small screens unless it collapses early.

options.label: Activity First
options.lineage: A personal viewing journal that places recent activity ahead of profile decoration.
options.thesis: Let the member's real viewing life tell the profile story.
options.viewport: A compact identity strip and member tabs sit above a full-width, date-grouped activity stream; Favorites and Lists appear as short, ordered shelves after the first journal entries. Circle activity uses the same readable event rows with author and visibility context.
options.risk: A member with little history may see a mostly empty opening unless the next action is designed carefully.

options.label: Journal Index
options.lineage: A well-organized film journal with compact rows, dates, and member-made collections.
options.thesis: Make large personal libraries quick to scan, filter, and continue using.
options.viewport: A narrow member identity column and labeled destination rail stay fixed beside a flexible content index. Diary entries, saved titles, and lists use compact rows with small artwork and clear state labels; Favorites remain an ordered six-title strip.
options.risk: A dense index can feel administrative if artwork and activity lose their personality.
